body.zh-Hant: 1887年11月24日生於柏林，本名弗里茨·埃里希·馮·萊溫斯基，是將軍之子，出生後不久由姨母及其夫婿格奧爾格·馮·曼施坦因收養。1900年進入軍校（Kadettenkorps）。第一次世界大戰期間任上尉等職，1914年身受重傷。1936年10月升任第一軍需長（Oberquartiermeister I），擔任參謀總長貝克的副手，並晉升少將。
body.en: Born in Berlin on 24 November 1887 as Fritz Erich von Lewinski, the son of an artillery general, he was soon adopted by an aunt and her husband Georg von Manstein. He entered the cadet corps in 1900, served in the First World War and was severely wounded in 1914. In October 1936 he became Oberquartiermeister I, deputy to Chief of the General Staff Beck, and was promoted Generalmajor.

body.zh-Hant: 1939年8月18日起任東線總司令（Oberbefehlshaber Ost）的參謀長；同年10月21日出任A集團軍群的「Chef」，籌備西線戰事。1940年1月起率第38軍；他提出的突破方案經希特勒下令納入規劃，5至6月的法國戰役中以「鐮刀收割」（Sichelschnitt）作戰成功實施，其軍則突破索姆河的法軍陣地。
body.en: From 18 August 1939 he was chief of staff to the Commander-in-Chief East, and on 21 October 1939 he became "Chef" of Army Group A, preparing the war in the West. From January 1940 he led XXXVIII Army Corps. His attack plan was taken into the planning on Hitler's order and was carried out in May–June 1940 as Operation "Sichelschnitt"; his corps broke through the French positions on the Somme.

body.zh-Hant: 1940年11月接掌駐東普魯士的第56裝甲軍。1941年6月22日起，在巴巴羅薩行動中該軍經波羅的海三國向列寧格勒推進。1941年9月13日他升任第11集團軍司令，主要任務是奪取克里米亞半島；塞瓦斯托波爾要塞於1942年7月1日陷落，其後他晉升元帥。
body.en: In November 1940 he took command of LVI Panzer Corps in East Prussia. From 22 June 1941, in Operation Barbarossa, it advanced through the Baltic states towards Leningrad. On 13 September 1941 he was appointed commander of the Eleventh Army, whose main task was the capture of the Crimea; after the fortress of Sevastopol fell on 1 July 1942 he was made Generalfeldmarschall.

heading.zh-Hant: 史達林格勒、堡壘作戰與解職

body.zh-Hant: 據LeMO，他1942年7月起另掌頓河集團軍群，7至11月試圖解救被困於史達林格勒的第6集團軍，但未成功。1943年7月5日南方集團軍群對庫爾斯克發動「堡壘」作戰；攻勢失敗後，德軍在東線轉入全面防禦。1944年3月31日希特勒解除其職務，將他留在自己的待命名單中。
body.en: According to LeMO he additionally took command of Army Group Don from July 1942 and tried in vain, from July to November, to relieve the Sixth Army encircled at Stalingrad. On 5 July 1943 Army Group South attacked at Kursk (Operation "Zitadelle"); after its failure the German army in the East went over to the defensive. On 31 March 1944 Hitler relieved him of his command and held him at his own disposal.

body.zh-Hant: 1945年8月26日被英軍逮捕。他因戰爭罪行在漢堡受英國軍事法庭審判，12月被判處18年徒刑；1953年5月7日提前獲釋。1973年6月11日逝於上巴伐利亞的伊爾森豪森。
body.en: He was arrested by British troops on 26 August 1945. Tried for war crimes before a British military court in Hamburg, he was sentenced in December to 18 years in prison and released early on 7 May 1953. He died on 11 June 1973 in Irschenhausen, Upper Bavaria.

body.zh-Hant: 1876年4月24日生於漢堡近郊的萬茲貝克。1894年中學畢業後入海軍成為海軍軍官候補生。1910至1912年任皇家遊艇「霍亨索倫」號的航海官。第一次世界大戰中他任參謀軍官，1916年5月31日隨希佩爾出戰斯卡格拉克（日德蘭）海戰。
body.en: Born on 24 April 1876 in Wandsbek near Hamburg, he entered the navy as a sea cadet in 1894 after his school-leaving exam. From 1910 to 1912 he was navigation officer on the imperial yacht "Hohenzollern". In the First World War he served as an admiralty staff officer and accompanied Hipper into the Battle of the Skagerrak on 31 May 1916.

body.zh-Hant: 1918年1月任小型巡洋艦「科隆」號艦長。1922年出任海軍教育局長，其後短暫任北海輕型海上兵力指揮官，1925年任波羅的海海軍基地司令。1928年10月1日在洛曼事件後接任海軍統帥部長（Chef der Marineleitung）。
body.en: In January 1918 he became commander of the light cruiser "Cöln". In 1922 he was appointed chief of naval education, then briefly commanded the light naval forces in the North Sea, and in 1925 became chief of the Baltic naval station. On 1 October 1928, after the Lohmann affair, he became Chef der Marineleitung.

body.zh-Hant: 在他任內，海軍於魏瑪共和國時期就以裝甲艦把規模擴充到《凡爾賽條約》所定上限之外。1933年他歡迎希特勒的重整軍備計畫，但嚴正警告勿與英國海上強權衝突。1935年6月1日他出任海軍總司令（Oberbefehlshaber der Kriegsmarine）兼海戰指導部長。
body.en: Under his responsibility the navy was expanded, still in the Weimar Republic, with armoured ships beyond the limit set by the Treaty of Versailles. In 1933 he welcomed Hitler's rearmament plans but warned emphatically against a conflict with British sea power. On 1 June 1935 he became Commander-in-Chief of the Navy (Oberbefehlshaber der Kriegsmarine) and head of the Seekriegsleitung.

body.zh-Hant: 1939年9月1日他被希特勒晉升為海軍大將（Großadmiral）。1940年4月9日入侵挪威與丹麥的「威瑟演習」作戰源於他的主張；1941年5月27日「俾斯麥」號被擊沉，水面艦隊的大西洋通商破壞戰就此告一段落。1943年1月30日他在與希特勒激烈爭執後辭職，由鄧尼茨接任總司令。
body.en: On 1 September 1939 Hitler promoted him to Großadmiral. The operation "Weserübung", the attack on Norway and Denmark on 9 April 1940, is traced back to him; with the destruction of the "Bismarck" on 27 May 1941 the phase of surface raiding in the Atlantic ended. After heated disputes with Hitler he resigned on 30 January 1943, and Karl Dönitz succeeded him as commander-in-chief.

die Operation „Weserübung“, der Überfall auf Norwegen und Dänemark am 9.4.1940

body.zh-Hant: 1946年他在紐倫堡主要戰犯審判中被判無期徒刑。1955年因健康惡化提前獲釋，晚年出版回憶錄《我的一生》（1956至1957年）。1960年11月6日逝於基爾。
body.en: In 1946 he was sentenced to life imprisonment in the Nuremberg trial of the major war criminals. He was released early in 1955 because of poor health, and his memoir "Mein Leben" appeared in 1956–57. He died in Kiel on 6 November 1960.

body.zh-Hant: 1861年9月11日生，為地主之子，軍校出身，1880年任少尉。1896年他以教官身分進入中國服務；1899年返回普魯士軍隊，隸屬瓦德西指揮的東亞遠征軍參謀部。1913年7月8日被指定接任普魯士陸軍大臣（Kriegsminister）。
body.en: Born on 11 September 1861, the son of an estate owner, he was brought up in the cadet corps and became a lieutenant in 1880. In 1896 he entered Chinese service as an instructor; in 1899 he rejoined the Prussian army and was assigned to the staff of the East Asian expeditionary corps under Waldersee. On 8 July 1913 he was named Prussian minister of war.

heading.en: War minister and Chief of the General Staff

body.zh-Hant: 1914年9月14日馬恩河戰役後，他接替毛奇指揮德國野戰軍的軍事行動，11月3日正式接任總參謀長（Chef des Generalstabs）。1915年1月20日他卸任陸軍大臣，同時晉升步兵上將。
body.en: After the Battle of the Marne, on 14 September 1914 he took over the direction of the military operations of the German field army in place of Moltke, and on 3 November he formally succeeded him as Chef des Generalstabs. On 20 January 1915 he gave up the Prussian war ministry and was promoted General of Infantry.

heading.zh-Hant: 戈爾利采、凡爾登與罷免

body.zh-Hant: 1915年5月，他與奧匈參謀總長共同策劃的戈爾利采突破成功，收復加利西亞。1916年2月21日德軍對凡爾登要塞發動攻擊，但以大量物資迫使西線決戰的企圖失敗。1916年8月29日羅馬尼亞參戰後，威廉二世將他免去總參謀長職務，由興登堡與魯登道夫接掌最高陸軍指揮部。
body.en: In May 1915 the breakthrough at Gorlice, planned with the Austrian chief of staff, succeeded and Galicia was reconquered. The German attack on the fortifications of Verdun began on 21 February 1916, but the attempt to force a decision in the West by massive use of materiel failed. On 29 August 1916, after Romania's declaration of war, Wilhelm II dismissed him as chief of the General Staff; Hindenburg and Ludendorff succeeded him in the Supreme Army Command.

heading.zh-Hant: 羅馬尼亞、巴勒斯坦與晚年

body.zh-Hant: 1916年9月16日他出任第9集團軍司令，領導對羅馬尼亞的作戰。1917年7月9日他接掌F集團軍群，9月30日另外兼管巴勒斯坦戰線，但只能採取防禦；1918年2月因與土耳其統帥部對立而被召回，改任第10集團軍司令，直至1919年2月該軍解散。1919年6月5日他依己請辭，1922年4月8日逝世。
body.en: On 16 September 1916 he took over the Ninth Army and led the operations against Romania. On 9 July 1917 he received Army Group F and, from 30 September, additionally the Palestine front, where he could only stand on the defensive; in February 1918, after sharp conflicts with the Turkish command, he was recalled and given the Tenth Army until its dissolution in February 1919. He was retired at his own request on 5 June 1919 and died on 8 April 1922.

heading.en: Origins and the capture of Liège

body.zh-Hant: 1865年4月9日生於波森省，為地主之子，1877至1882年在軍校受教。他走的是一般總參謀軍官的仕途，1912年調任杜塞道夫團長，1914年升旅長。一戰爆發後，1914年8月6日他率一支失去指揮官的旅奪取列日要塞的城堡，獲頒功勳勳章，被稱為「列日英雄」。
body.en: Born on 9 April 1865 in the province of Posen, the son of an estate owner, he was trained in cadet schools from 1877 to 1882. He followed the usual career of a general staff officer, became a regimental commander in Düsseldorf in 1912 and a brigade commander in 1914. After the outbreak of war, on 6 August 1914 he led a brigade whose commander had fallen out and took the citadel of Liège; he received the Pour le Mérite and was known as the "hero of Liège".

heading.en: East Prussia: Tannenberg and the Masurian Lakes

body.zh-Hant: 1914年8月22日他被任命為第8集團軍參謀長，上司是復出的興登堡。LeMO記載，8月26至30日的坦能堡戰役中俄軍第2集團軍遭到殲滅，9月6至15日的馬祖里湖戰役則擊敗俄軍第1集團軍。11月1日興登堡與魯登道夫取得東線全部德軍的最高指揮權（Ober-Ost）。
body.en: On 22 August 1914 he was appointed chief of staff of the Eighth Army under the reactivated Hindenburg. According to LeMO, the Russian Second Army was destroyed at Tannenberg on 26–30 August and the Russian First Army was defeated in the Battle of the Masurian Lakes on 6–15 September. On 1 November Hindenburg and Ludendorff received the supreme command of all German troops on the Eastern Front (Ober-Ost).

heading.zh-Hant: 最高陸軍指揮部與總體戰
heading.en: Supreme Army Command and total war

body.zh-Hant: 1916年8月29日法金漢去職後，興登堡接掌最高陸軍指揮部（OHL），魯登道夫擔任專為他設的「第一總軍需長」，藉此確保對一切決策的「完全共同責任」。1917年7月13日他在推翻帝國總理貝特曼·霍爾韋格一事上扮演關鍵角色。1918年3月3日布列斯特—立陶夫斯克和約簽訂，魯登道夫力主向東大幅擴張。
body.en: After Falkenhayn's dismissal on 29 August 1916, Hindenburg took over the Supreme Army Command (OHL) with Ludendorff as First Quartermaster General, a title created for him that secured him "full co-responsibility" for all decisions. On 13 July 1917 he played a decisive part in the fall of Chancellor Bethmann Hollweg. He pressed for extensive expansion in the East at Brest-Litovsk, where the dictated peace was concluded on 3 March 1918.

heading.en: The 1918 offensives, armistice demand and dismissal

body.zh-Hant: 1918年3月21日起的春季攻勢只取得戰術性成功，沒有戰略效果。9月29日最高陸軍指揮部在攻勢失敗後要求立即進行停戰談判；10月26日魯登道夫被解職。
body.en: The offensives that began on 21 March 1918 achieved only tactical successes without strategic effect. On 29 September, after the failure of the spring offensive, the OHL demanded immediate armistice negotiations; on 26 October Ludendorff was dismissed from service.

heading.zh-Hant: 希特勒政變、國會與晚年
heading.en: The Hitler putsch, Reichstag and later years

body.zh-Hant: 1923年11月9日他與希特勒在慕尼黑共同發動政變，被擊潰；1924年2月在叛國審判中被控後獲判無罪。1924至1928年他以民族社會主義自由黨議員身分出任國會議員。1925年3月29日參選帝國總統，首輪僅得1.1%選票。1937年12月20日逝於上巴伐利亞的圖青。
body.en: The putsch he carried out together with Hitler in Munich on 9 November 1923 was crushed; in February 1924 he was tried for high treason and acquitted. From 1924 to 1928 he sat in the Reichstag as a deputy of the National Socialist Freedom Party. On 29 March 1925 he ran for Reich President and received 1.1 per cent in the first round. He died in Tutzing on 20 December 1937.

body.zh-Hant: 1882年9月22日生於布倫瑞克附近的赫爾姆舍羅德，為地主之子。1901年中學畢業後入炮兵團任見習軍官，1914年隨團上西線。1915年未經一般訓練即調入大總參謀部，1919年編入國防軍。1933年任波茨坦步兵指揮官，1934至1935年任第22師師長（駐不來梅）。
body.en: Born on 22 September 1882 in Helmscherode near Brunswick, the son of an estate owner, he entered an artillery regiment as an officer cadet after his school-leaving exam in 1901 and went to the Western Front with it in 1914. In 1915 he was posted to the Great General Staff without the usual preparation and in 1919 he was taken into the Reichswehr. In 1933 he became infantry commander in Potsdam and in 1934–35 commanded the 22nd Division in Bremen.

heading.zh-Hant: 國防軍辦公室與國防軍最高統帥部

body.zh-Hant: 1935年10月1日他被任命為帝國戰爭部國防軍辦公室主任。1938年初布洛姆貝格—弗里奇危機後，帝國戰爭部長一職不再補人，希特勒自任國防軍統帥，並任命凱特爾為新設國防軍最高統帥部（OKW）的首長。該職依NDB權限有限，沒有指揮權，LeMO也指出它主要是供希特勒軍事諮詢之用。
body.en: On 1 October 1935 he was appointed chief of the Wehrmachtamt in the Reich War Ministry. After the Blomberg–Fritsch crisis in early 1938 the post of Reich war minister was not refilled; Hitler made himself commander-in-chief of the Wehrmacht and appointed Keitel chief of the newly created Oberkommando der Wehrmacht (OKW). According to the NDB the post lacked any power of command, and LeMO notes it was created mainly to advise Hitler militarily.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰時：希特勒最親近的軍事顧問

body.zh-Hant: 第二次世界大戰期間，凱特爾基於無條件的忠誠，原則上站在希特勒一邊。他於1940年晉升元帥；LeMO記載他起初反對進攻蘇聯，但仍是希特勒最親近的軍事顧問。NDB 指出，他以個人姓名簽署違反國際法的命令，例如1941年6月6日的〈政委命令〉。
body.en: During the Second World War, out of unconditional loyalty, he took Hitler's side as a matter of principle. He was made Generalfeldmarschall in 1940; LeMO records that he at first rejected the attack on the Soviet Union but remained Hitler's closest military adviser. According to the NDB he put his name to orders contrary to international law, for example the Commissar Order of 6 June 1941.

body.zh-Hant: 1945年5月，他在柏林—卡爾斯霍斯特代表鄧尼茨簽署德國國防軍向紅軍無條件投降（LeMO記為9日，NDB記為8日）；5月13日被盟軍俘虜。1946年10月1日，紐倫堡國際軍事法庭判處他死刑，10月16日在紐倫堡被絞死。
body.en: In May 1945 he signed the unconditional surrender of the Wehrmacht to the Red Army at Berlin-Karlshorst on Dönitz's behalf (LeMO gives the 9th, the NDB the 8th); on 13 May the Allies took him prisoner. On 1 October 1946 the International Military Tribunal at Nuremberg sentenced him to death, and he was hanged at Nuremberg on 16 October 1946.
